title: "Firm-Level Effects of Energy Price Increases: Evidence and Insights from Recent Research"
date: 2024-07-19

description: "A synthesis of recent evidence on how energy-subsidy reform affects firms, for the World Bank."

A new World Bank synthesis pulling together recent evidence on how energy-subsidy reform affects firms, with recommendations for evaluating future policy impacts — following on from the earlier Chile and Oman firm-level work.
